intro.text: A fungus that gives off a dim blue light as it grows on glowstones, which are large, porous rocks. Kandra grow eyes made specially to see by its glow.
A glowing fungus found only in the kandra Homeland. Its dim blue light is what kandra grow special eyes to see by.

description.text: TenSoon notices that the Trustwarren uses no glowstones for light, relying instead on oil lamps with blue glass.
